requirement: Joomla content planner: the model gets a slot's words and limits, not the page list or where Joomla stores the value

oracle.ref: PR #893 (fix); fix evidence: 05/10/2026 local stand, planning tracy-business/j6/1.2.0 for one language as Apply does: 25 model calls carried 491k characters, 164k of them the same 78-page list in every call; 138.8k prompt tokens per plan. After the fix: 224.6k characters, 66.7k prompt tokens (median of 6 real runs, -52%), slots written 482 -> 514 (median), no demo words in written values (tasks/evidence/add-site-apply-audit/joomla-planner-tokens.md).
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 19); the named test is 'ok': no page list in the model input, no JSON path, XPath, nested-JSON name or site-identity flag on a slot, `current` only when it differs from `sample`, `requiresEvidence` only when true, the element of an XPath slot kept.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
